document.name: GCLeadHub
document.author: OpenAI + Founder
document.description: GCLeadHub is an AI-powered Contractor Opportunity Intelligence Platform that helps contractors identify, prioritize, and win profitable construction opportunities before competitors.

vision.mission: Enable every contractor to know where the next profitable project will originate before the market does.
vision.visionStatement: Become the intelligence platform contractors open every morning before deciding where to bid.
vision.tagline: Know what to bid before everyone else.
vision.elevatorPitch: GCLeadHub continuously analyzes property, ownership, permit, demographic, regulatory, and market intelligence to surface construction opportunities ranked by probability, value, urgency, and strategic fit.

problem: Contractors waste significant time searching for projects that are not ready to buy.
Existing platforms provide data but not intelligence.
Construction opportunities are fragmented across many disconnected systems.
Most bidding is reactive rather than proactive.
solution: Aggregate opportunity signals from multiple trusted sources.
Rank projects using AI-driven opportunity scoring.
Reduce prospecting time while increasing win probability.
customerOutcome: Grow revenue with fewer sales resources.

guidingPrinciples.name: Intelligence First
guidingPrinciples.description: Every screen should help users make better decisions, not simply display data.

guidingPrinciples.name: Explain Every Recommendation
guidingPrinciples.description: Every score must include evidence explaining why it was generated.

guidingPrinciples.name: Property Centric
guidingPrinciples.description: Properties are first-class intelligence objects connected to companies, owners, permits, and projects.

guidingPrinciples.name: Continuous Discovery
guidingPrinciples.description: The platform continuously discovers new opportunities instead of relying solely on user searches.

guidingPrinciples.name: Evidence Based
guidingPrinciples.description: Every insight is backed by verifiable evidence.

northStarMetric.definition: Number of AI-ranked opportunities resulting in contractor engagement.

year3: Become primary opportunity intelligence platform for contractors

nonGoals: Compete directly with Procore's project execution platform
architectureRules: Every recommendation must be traceable to evidence.
Every opportunity belongs to a property.
Every property can have multiple owners over time.
Every company may participate in multiple projects.
AI explanations are generated from evidence, never fabricated.
No module may directly modify historical evidence.

opportunityLifecycleEngine.description: Every opportunity moves through a structured lifecycle, enabling GCLeadHub to learn from outcomes and improve recommendations over time.

stages.description: Signal identified from source data (permits, property changes, etc.)
Signal cross-referenced and confirmed as a genuine opportunity
AI-driven scoring applied for value, urgency, fit, and win probability
Opportunity routed to appropriate contractor or team
Formal proposal or bid delivered to the client

opportunityLifecycleEngine.feedbackLoop: Outcomes (Won/Lost) feed back into the scoring model, improving future opportunity ranking.

evidenceConfidenceModel.description: Every fact carries provenance and confidence, making AI reasoning auditable rather than opaque.

components.confidenceScore: 0–100% confidence based on corroborating evidence sources
components.display: Each fact shown with confidence bar and checkmarked evidence sources

rules: Confidence is derived from number and reliability of corroborating sources.
Conflicting sources reduce confidence rather than being discarded.
All evidence is timestamped and source-tagged.

opportunityGraph.description: The Opportunity Graph models relationships between entities, enabling relationship-driven insights that go beyond isolated records.

relationships.Property → Opportunity: Detected opportunities linked to the property

strategicQueries: Which architects consistently specify premium roofing systems?
Which management companies prefer negotiated work over competitive bidding?
Which GCs frequently win projects from a given developer?
opportunityGraph.moatRationale: Over time, relationship-driven insights move the platform beyond a lead database into a true intelligence system. The graph compounds as more data flows in, creating increasing returns to scale.

designGoals: Large touch targets for field use.
Fast keyboard navigation for office users.

opportunityIntelligenceEngine.name: Opportunity Intelligence Engine (OIE)
opportunityIntelligenceEngine.relationshipToIIE: Distinct from IIE (Index Intelligence Engine). OIE consumes normalized data from IIE and adds construction-specific intelligence. IIE powers all verticals; OIE is GCLeadHub's unique competitive moat.
opportunityIntelligenceEngine.purpose: Transform raw property, ownership, permit, market, and behavioral signals into ranked construction opportunities with transparent AI reasoning.

opportunityScore.purpose: Overall likelihood that pursuing this opportunity will generate profitable work.

distressScore.purpose: Likelihood that the property requires repair, renovation, or deferred maintenance.

capitalImprovementScore.purpose: Probability of major renovation or capital expenditure within 24 months.

urgencyScore.purpose: Measures how quickly contractor engagement is likely needed.

competitionScore.purpose: Measures expected competition from other contractors.

revenuePotential.purpose: Estimated revenue opportunity normalized across project types.

relationshipScore.purpose: Likelihood existing relationships improve win probability.

confidenceScore.purpose: Confidence in the AI's recommendation based on available evidence.

seasonalityScore.purpose: Predicts optimal time of year to approach a property based on project type and regional construction patterns.

fundingProbabilityScore.purpose: Estimates whether financing or capital is likely available by combining ownership history, assessed value trends, and public investment indicators.

repeatCustomerProbability.purpose: Identifies owners, property managers, or developers with recurring renovation cycles.

opportunityDecayScore.purpose: Estimates how quickly an opportunity loses value if no action is taken, helping prioritize outreach.

projectTimingForecast.purpose: Predicts when a project is most likely to move from planning to bidding based on historical timelines and similar projects.

relationshipPathEngine.purpose: Maps indirect connections (owner → architect → developer → previous contractor → supplier) to uncover warm introductions.

additionalPredictiveSignals: Seasonality Score — predicts optimal time of year to approach based on project type and regional patterns
Funding Probability Score — estimates capital availability from ownership history, value trends, and public investment
Repeat Customer Probability — identifies entities with recurring renovation cycles
Opportunity Decay Score — estimates how quickly value drops if no action is taken
Project Timing Forecast — predicts when planning transitions to bidding based on historical timelines

crm.purpose: Manage companies, contacts, opportunities, communications, relationships, and sales workflows around construction opportunities — opportunity-centric, not contact-centric.
crm.strategicPosition: Lightweight and optimized for construction opportunity management. Not a Salesforce/HubSpot competitor. If customers use another CRM, synchronize. The CRM's primary job is to capture and act on property intelligence and opportunity intelligence.

outreachEngine.purpose: Generate, personalize, automate, and optimize outreach campaigns based on construction opportunity intelligence.
outreachEngine.strategicPosition: Construction-specific sales intelligence — not a Mailchimp/HubSpot competitor. Every message tied to a real opportunity (permit, ownership change, aging building, renovation signal) so outreach is timely and relevant. The AI should orchestrate outreach (who/when/what/reference/follow-up), not just generate content.

proposalGenerator.strategicNote: The AI Proposal Builder is a key productivity feature and adoption driver. Contractors spend hours assembling proposals — generating a polished first draft from the opportunity record, company profile, and historical templates saves significant time.

mapsAndSpatialIntelligence.purpose: Interactive GIS-powered mapping system for discovering, prioritizing, and managing construction opportunities geographically.
mapsAndSpatialIntelligence.strategicPosition: The map is not a pin-drop visualization — it is a query interface into the Opportunity Intelligence Engine. This makes GCLeadHub a spatial intelligence platform, not just a CRM with a map tab.

opportunityRadiusEngine.purpose: Automatically identify adjacent work instead of searching one building at a time.
opportunityRadiusEngine.example: Roofing permit → Neighbor replacing HVAC → Next-door property sold → Same owner owns 12 buildings nearby → 'Visit all 12 while you're there.'

routeOpportunityOptimization.purpose: Contractor version of a salesperson's route planner — optimizes visit order by estimated revenue, travel cost, and nearby opportunities.

constructionCorridorDetection.purpose: Detect corridors where construction activity is accelerating before competitors.
constructionCorridorDetection.example: New school → Road widening → Apartment complex → Retail center → Utility upgrades → Probability of additional projects: High

propertyPortfolioView.purpose: Click an owner and display every property they own across cities. Salespeople sell to owners, not just buildings.
propertyPortfolioView.example: ABC Holdings → 42 Buildings → 7 Cities → 3 Currently Renovating → 5 Permits Pending → 2 Buildings Sold

projectRadiusIntelligence.purpose: When viewing a permit, show nearby similar projects, competitors, average contract size, nearby subs, material suppliers, equipment rental, waste facilities.

marketExpansionTool.purpose: Answer 'Where should I open my next office?' using revenue density, permit density, competition, drive times, labor availability, population growth, building age, project mix.

whiteSpaceAnalysis.purpose: Highlight underserved areas where opportunity exceeds contractor capacity.
whiteSpaceAnalysis.example: County A: 42 active contractors, 5,100 projects, 18-day avg response → High opportunity

aiTerritoryBuilder.purpose: Automatically divide territories to balance workload by equal opportunity, travel, revenue potential, and minimized driving.

timeMachine.purpose: View changes over time with a slider (2022→2026). See construction growth, permit trends, property sales, neighborhood transformation to identify emerging markets.

opportunityForecastMap.purpose: Predict where projects are likely to emerge in the next 6-18 months based on permit velocity, property sales, population growth, infrastructure spending, commercial vacancies, business openings, municipal planning.

propertyIntelligence.purpose: Unified property intelligence engine providing ownership, history, regulatory, financial, environmental, and construction insights for every parcel.
propertyIntelligence.strategicPosition: Every property becomes a living asset record that continuously accumulates evidence. Most contractor CRMs stop at owner name and tax records — GCLH builds a 360° profile. This is one of the highest-value modules in the platform.

aiPropertySummary.purpose: Every property automatically gets an executive summary highlighting age, recent permits, renovation likelihood, and estimated opportunity value.

capitalImprovementPredictor.purpose: Predicts what owners are likely to spend money on — roof nearing end of life, HVAC replacement, ADA upgrades, fire sprinkler upgrades, parking lot resurfacing, solar retrofit, EV chargers, building modernization.

buildingLifecycleScore.purpose: Every building receives a lifecycle rating across Structure, Roof, Mechanical, Electrical, Exterior with an overall score (0-100).

propertyTimeline.purpose: Everything becomes one chronological story — built → roof replaced → tenant improvement → sold → electrical upgrade → solar installed → violation → new permit.

ownerPortfolioIntelligence.purpose: Click an owner to see portfolio size, property types, total value, recent activity (sales, permits, remodels, developments).

renovationProbabilityScore.purpose: AI predicts likelihood of work within 12-24 months based on building age, permit frequency, recent sale, code violations, tenant turnover, property value, neighborhood growth, comparable renovations.

contractorHistory.purpose: Identify which contractors have previously worked on the property — valuable competitive intelligence.

aiOpportunityTimeline.purpose: Predicts upcoming opportunities in next 6 months (HVAC Medium, Roof High, Interior Remodel High, Exterior Paint Low, Parking Lot Medium).

documentIntelligence.purpose: Auto-index building plans, permit PDFs, inspection reports, environmental reports, engineering drawings, site plans, deeds, easements, CC&Rs with AI search.

propertyDigitalTwin.purpose: Future enterprise feature — living operational profile with current condition, construction history, permit history, contractors, utility profile, maintenance timeline, capital improvements, risk and opportunity indicators. Every property evolves into a continuously updated digital record.

searchEngine.purpose: Enterprise intelligence search platform supporting structured, semantic, geospatial, and AI-powered discovery across all indexed construction opportunities.
searchEngine.strategicPosition: The Search Engine is the Intelligence Query Layer — the front door to every intelligence module. Users ask questions, not just search properties. Combined with IIE's provider system and graph, this becomes one of the platform's biggest differentiators.

pages.title: Query DSL Builder
pages.description: Visual and advanced query language for power users.

intelligenceSearch.purpose: Instead of requiring users to build complex filters, let them search naturally. The AI translates natural language into the internal Query DSL.
exampleQueries: Show apartment complexes over 30 years old
Find shopping centers that haven't remodeled recently
Show buildings likely needing HVAC replacement
Find schools with upcoming capital improvement opportunities
Industrial buildings sold within the last year
Churches with roof permits older than 20 years

visualQueryBuilder.purpose: Drag-and-drop interface for non-technical contractors. Each condition row has Property Type → AND → Built Before → AND → Roof Permit → AND → Within → ORDER BY Opportunity Score.

aiSearchSuggestions.purpose: While typing 'roof': suggest Roof nearing end of life, Roof permits, Roof replacements, Roof violations, Roof opportunities

watchlistTypes.ownerWatch: Notify when property sells, new permits, violations, tax delinquency, remodel begins
watchlistTypes.cityWatch: Notify when industrial permits exceed $5M, schools issue remodel permits, retail projects begin
watchlistTypes.propertyWatch: Notify when owner changes, permit filed, violation issued, building sold, tax delinquent

smartRecommendations.purpose: After searching Apartment Remodels, suggest Hotels, Senior Living, Student Housing, Mixed Use Developments

searchAnalytics.purpose: Show top searches, search frequency trends, and user behavior patterns.

aiQueryOptimizer.purpose: After a search returns only 8 results, suggest expanding radius, including 25-35 year old buildings, removing permit restriction — estimated results: 147

similarResults.purpose: Every property has a Find Similar button showing similarity percentage across Age, Location, Ownership, Permit History, Opportunity Score

advancedFeatures: Semantic Search — vector embeddings for find buildings similar to this one
Graph Search — show owners connected to XYZ contractor
Search Collections — share curated searches with team
Cross-Search Comparison — compare two saved searches for newly qualified opportunities
Search Replay — re-run historical search against today's data
Opportunity Delta View — highlight only new/changed results since last run
Federated Search — unified search across permits, properties, companies, contacts, documents, maps, CRM

organizationAndAdministration.purpose: Multi-tenant organization management, user administration, permissions, billing, API access, audit logging, and enterprise governance.
organizationAndAdministration.strategicPosition: Designed for enterprise from day one — targets everyone from single GCs to large regional contractors and franchises. Most functionality won't be used by small customers initially, but avoids a major rewrite later.

enterpriseFeatures.whiteLabel: Custom logo, colors, domain, client portal branding
enterpriseFeatures.franchises: Parent organization, multiple branches, independent billing, shared opportunity pool, regional reporting
enterpriseFeatures.multiOffice: Territory assignment, office-level dashboards, shared CRM and search history, cross-office collaboration
enterpriseFeatures.apiManagement: Per-key rate limits, usage analytics, request logs, API scopes, webhook subscriptions, IP allowlists
enterpriseFeatures.compliance: Complete audit trail, soft delete with recovery, data retention policies, GDPR/CCPA readiness, export logs, user consent records
enterpriseFeatures.teamPerformance: Opportunities assigned, win rate, revenue generated, response time, outreach completed, pipeline value, activity heatmap
enterpriseFeatures.orgSettings: Default search radius, preferred property types, target building age, opportunity score thresholds, notification preferences, AI model settings, email templates, proposal branding

organizationKnowledgeBase.purpose: Key differentiator — most CRMs don't have this. Every search, note, property visit, bid outcome, contractor observation, and customer interaction becomes searchable institutional knowledge. Instead of disappearing when an employee leaves, it becomes the organization's long-term intelligence.
examples: John met the property manager in 2024.
Roof replacement was postponed due to budget.
Estimator visited and identified structural concerns.
organizationKnowledgeBase.strategicValue: Over time, this becomes a significant competitive advantage and one of the platform's strongest retention mechanisms.

overview.purpose: Scalable, observable, multi-tenant platform for continuously ingesting, processing, scoring, and serving contractor opportunity intelligence across multiple markets.
overview.architecture: Cloud-native with asynchronous processing, event-driven ingestion, shared intelligence services, and tenant isolation.

deployment.goal: Enterprise-grade deployment, observability, scalability, security, and operational tooling — inexpensive during MVP, easily scalable to enterprise workloads.

platformPositioning.tagline: The Opportunity Intelligence Platform for General Contractors
platformPositioning.differentiation: Not another CRM or property search tool. Instead of helping contractors manage jobs after they're won, GCLeadHub helps them discover, qualify, prioritize, and win profitable work before competitors.
